hooks.name: FraudLens grounding & safety review
hooks.description: When agent, AI, tool, or policy code is saved, checks evidence grounding, LLM boundaries, and action safety.

action.prompt: FraudLens agent/AI/tool/policy code was just saved. Check it against .kiro/steering/fraud-domain.md and genai-standards.md: (1) numeric calculations happen only in tools, never in prompts or the LLM; (2) every tool result becomes Evidence with an EV- ID, and failures become status=unavailable; (3) Gemini output uses the InvestigationSummary schema and citations are post-validated; (4) agents cannot call simulate_restriction, record_action, or create_case; (5) the policy engine stays pure and deterministic with no LLM call, and POLICY_VERSION is bumped if thresholds changed; (6) no PII or raw transaction dumps go into prompts or logs; (7) model IDs come from settings. Report violations in 5 bullets or fewer and fix clear ones.
